title: U.S. Targets Ship-to-Ship Transfers in Expanded Iran Maritime Blockade
body: The US military will treat ships that receive cargo at sea from vessels loaded in Iran as attempting to evade its blockade of Iranian ports and could take action against them, according to an advisory issued by US Central Command (CENTCOM) on Wednesday.
